description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Sri Lanka Export Development Act No. 40 of 1979 order under Section 14
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework. It specifically modifies CESS levy rates on imported goods as per the Sri Lanka-Singapore Free Trade Agreement, representing a regulatory change to existing trade and customs regulations. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is only in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory order, not as a personnel appointment or with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content primarily focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government structure or personnel changes.
